editorial.name: OpenUnit
editorial.descriptionZh: 自助仓储（self-storage）行业的管理软件：CRM、支付与 POS、营销建站与 SEO、团队排班、会计记账装在同一个后台里，从单店到多站点运营商都覆盖。
editorial.takeawayZh: 给仓储门店换一套自带支付和建站的后台
editorial.noteZh: 米色底首屏，左边四行深绿衬线大字 Everything you need to run your self-storage facilities, whether you're big or small.，下面一枚深绿按钮 Get a demo — it's free，落款写 Contact us to learn how OpenUnit software can work at your self-storage facilities. Our team will be in touch within 24 hours.。右边是后台截图，左栏挂 Facility Manager、Direct Messages、Sales Channels，主区第一句 Good morning, Jacqueline.，Today's leads 143,209、Today's rental sales $1,342.20，后面四张指标卡是 Loads 21、Active Rentals 474、Occupancy 94.8%、Aspiring Payment $5,292.88，右下还有一条 Unread Conversations 里租户的留言。再往下 All the tools you need in one OpenUnit account. 一节把 CRM、Payments & Point of Sale Terminal、Marketing Website & SEO、Team Chat、Accounting 逐块列出，右下角一直浮着一个 Questions? Talk to our team 的气泡。
editorial.pricing: unknown（导航有 /pricing，首页只给 Get a Demo — it's free）
